name: Verimail Email Verification Free
free_limit: 100 email address verifications per month at no cost, using the same API and bulk file verification as paid accounts; unknown results, duplicate addresses within a file, and syntax errors do not consume credits.
watch_out: Monthly free allowance is limited to 100 checks; the API returns HTTP 402 when credits are exhausted until paid credits are purchased or a plan is upgraded. Do not confuse verimail.io with similarly named verimail.co or verimails.com. Confirm account eligibility and data-processing terms before uploading personal information.
